Metadata.title: Hissiyat | Analysis dashboard
Metadata.description: A synthetic analysis demonstration for human experience and search interest.

Dashboard.title: Analysis dashboard
Dashboard.intro: Explore online human experience and search interest in two separate data views.
Dashboard.notice: All values are fictional and cannot be used as research findings.

human.source: Fictional text data · Inspired by the CareerNet pilot
human.title: Human experience analysis
human.description: Topics, emotions, needs and experiences in writing about education and careers.
human.method: In these fixed fictional aggregates, each label counts the documents that carry it. Each share uses the selected cohort’s document total. A document can carry several labels, so shares can add up to more than 100%.
human.limit: Emotion labels reflect explicit expressions by fictional authors. These examples provide no evidence about psychological states, population prevalence, model performance or independent human evaluation.

caveats.general: A general sample from the fictional source frame. Shares use this cohort’s document count.
caveats.uncertainty-enriched: A sample enriched using fictional uncertainty cues. Its shares describe this cohort only.

search.source: Fictional time series · Inspired by Google Trends
search.title: Search interest analysis
search.description: A weekly relative interest index for a fictional search query.
search.coverage: {observed, number} of {weeks, number} weeks have values
search.chartLabel: Weekly fictional search interest. The line breaks at missing or suppressed weeks.
search.method: The fixed fictional series uses a relative index on a 0–100 scale. Missing and suppressed weeks have no numeric value and remain gaps in the line.
search.limit: The index contains no actual Google Trends measurements, counts of people or absolute search volumes. It is independent of the text cohorts and cannot establish causation between the two views.

states.invalid: The demo response did not match the expected contract.
